item.title: [LOW] One Million Passports Leaked Online
item.description: A database of almost a million passports from around the world was leaked online. Note what happened. A high-value credential—a passport—was used in an ancillary low-value authentication system: ID verification for cannabis dispensaries. And it’s the low-value system that got hacked, putting the high-value credential at risk.

item.title: [LOW] Interesting Paper Exploring Prompt Injection
